About the Portal

The Nephrotic Syndrome Knowledge Portal aggregates, analyzes, and displays information on rare genetic variation linked to nephrotic syndrome.

Learn about the cohorts >
field_about_project:
About the project

The Nephrotic Syndrome Knowledge Portal (NephKP) is being developed by the Sampson and Hildebrandt labs at Boston Children’s Hospital, the Pollak lab at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, the Sanna-Cherchi lab at Columbia University Irving Medical Center, and a team of scientists and software engineers at the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard. 

We welcome contributions of data and the involvement of interested researchers in collaborations on analyses, methods, or tool development. Please contact us for more information.

NephKP is funded by NIH/NIDDK RC2DK122397.
